note: KEPT-OVERRIDE PROOF (Phase B, real shipped float-rules.json via rules_path): the WezTerm 'wm.surface.notes-panel' window. The narrowed real file MUST keep the surface_notes_panel manage:on rule declared LAST, after the broad surface_transient manage:off — so last-match-wins re-manages it ⇒ float_verdict 'on' AND caps pass ⇒ tileable TRUE. The notes-panel is the one wm surface that tiles; the override's ordering is load-bearing and survives the narrowing. If the override is dropped or reordered before surface_transient, the panel flips to float and this goes red.
